title: Volcanoes of Oceania (guided)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Oceania, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders to help you.

rounds.name: Tafahi
rounds.fact: Tafahi is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 546 m in the source data. The data places it in Tonga.
